statement: Terminal-provided OSC 8 and unknown-kind links are not dispatched directly: malformed, deceptive-character, inaccessible and executable local targets are denied, well-understood HTTP(S)/mailto and safe local files may open, and custom schemes require user confirmation. The alert displays normalized/escaped target text and Cancel is the default.
consequence: A terminal-produced link could otherwise dispatch to a registered application or open an executable/local target without the user seeing the effective destination.
